# `q015_dest_inv_paymemo_v1.txt` with its payment's date changed from
# 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-12. A different date describes a different movement,
# so the payment the invoice had is left orphaned and a new one is recorded.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-DEST-PMOD-125"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 125
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-DEST-PMOD-125"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-12
		amount: 72
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Partial paymod-original"
